reactions.triggerDescription: Whenever you Boost or make a standard move
reactions.effectDescription:
You project a holographic pattern around you, leaving dazzling afterimages that make it hard to discern your precise location: you count as Invisible the next time you’re attacked.

You can only benefit from one instance of this effect at a time.

reactions.triggerDescription: A character ends a movement adjacent to you.
reactions.effectDescription: You may Boost, ignoring reactions and engagement. After doing so, attacks against you receive +1 Difficulty until the end of your next turn.

reactions.evaluate:
// Run only if combat is over, not if the token is deleted, and we aren't at full hp.
return ! game.combat && reactorToken.actor.system.hp.value < reactorToken.actor.system.hp.max;
